verdict.rationale: Polar's docs describe an automated dunning flow. A failed renewal moves the subscription to past_due instead of canceling it, Polar emails the customer a Customer Portal link to update their payment method, and charges are retried automatically on a published schedule (2, 5, 7, 7 days, up to 21 days). The retry schedule is fixed rather than 'smart' (adaptive or optimized), and nothing shows finance-ops can configure it. missing for 10: smart/adaptive retry timing, configurable retry schedule or email content, independent or hands-on corroboration of recovery performance.
